lines.text: Many learners say: We arrived to the hotel late.
Better: We arrived at the hotel late.
At! We arrived at the hotel.

data.wrong: We arrived to the hotel late.
data.right: We arrived at the hotel late.
data.memory: We arrived at the hotel late.

native.tip: Türkçedeki “-e vardık” İngilizcede “to” olmaz; “arrived at” deriz: “We arrived at the hotel late.”
native.caption: “We arrived to the hotel late” mi diyorsun? 😅 “Arrived” sözcüğünden sonra “to” değil, “at” gelir. Doğrusu “We arrived at the hotel late.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “at”. Bir yere varınca “arrived at” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: After “arrived”, use “at”: “We arrived at the hotel late.”
en.caption: Do you say “We arrived to the hotel late”? 😅 In English we say arrived at, not arrived to. The right sentence is “We arrived at the hotel late.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
